description: This file is a server-side JavaScript script implementing CGI-like functionality, including header management, session handling, and parsing of POST, GET, and FILES data for web applications.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Accumulates HTTP headers into a buffer, handling special cases for 'location' and 'content-type'.

methods.name: echo
methods.description: Appends content to the output buffer to be sent in the HTTP response.

methods.name: _jst_finish
methods.description: Outputs accumulated headers and content, finalizing the HTTP response.

methods.name: _jst_exit_exception
methods.description: Custom exception class for handling script exit.

methods.name: exit
methods.description: Throws an exit exception to terminate script execution gracefully.

methods.name: session_start
methods.description: Initializes session management, setting cookies and session data proxies.

methods.name: session_create
methods.description: Creates a new session and sets corresponding cookies and data proxies.

methods.name: session_destroy
methods.description: Destroys the current session and clears session data.

methods.name: session_unset
methods.description: Placeholder for unsetting session variables (not implemented).
